message.content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "override_negative_automated_findings_with_visual_inspection", "description": "When automated classifiers or report generators return negative/normal results but visual evidence suggests subtle structural anomalies (e.g., tubular opacities, hyperlucency), prioritize direct pixel-level inspection over tool outputs.", "applicable_conditions": "Applicable when interpreting medical imaging (specifically chest X-rays) where automated tools provide low-confidence or normal findings that contradict distinct morphological patterns visible in the raw image data.", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["medical_imaging_interpretation"], "required_tools": ["chest_xray_classifier", "chest_xray_report_generator"], "risk_level": "high", "core_action": "If `chest_xray_classifier` and `chest_xray_report_generator` return normal/negative results but the image displays distinct morphological patterns (such as tubular opacities or localized hyperlucency): (1) Disregard the automated 'normal' conclusion; (2) Perform direct visual inspection of the original image pixels to identify subtle structural anomalies; (3) Document findings based on visual evidence rather than tool scores."}, "patch_target_id": null, "patch_section": null, "patch_content": null}
